office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the Superior Court: the office keeps the court's case files and records and supports its operations.
race_blurb: Clerk Melanie Breezee, appointed in 2021 and elected unopposed in 2022, faces Sheri L. Mott, who reports 30 years of business management and more than a decade in the Pierce County court system; both prefer the Republican Party. Breezee led the August primary 1,200 to 851.

candidates.summary: Ferry County Clerk since an August 2021 appointment, elected in 2022, after starting as a deputy clerk in 2020.
highlights: Deputy clerk from November 2020, appointed clerk in August 2021, elected in 2022 [S1][S3]
Promises 'professional, accurate, and dependable service' and transparency in the office [S1]

experience.basis: Sitting clerk since 2021 who asks to 'continue serving' on her record in the office.

candidates.summary: Business owner and mediator who reports more than 10 years in the Pierce County court system; sits on the state Wolf Advisory Group and two Ferry County advisory boards.
highlights: Reports 30 years of management, including a real-estate company and a domestic-law mediation company [S1]
Bachelor's degree in law and justice; more than 10 years in the Pierce County court system [S1]
Member of the state Wolf Advisory Group (livestock producer) and the county Civil Service and Solid Waste advisory groups [S1][S2]
Promises 'steady leadership, accountability, and common-sense administration' [S1]

experience.basis: Never held elected office and challenges the incumbent, but brings management and court-system experience, so the outsider case is partial.
